capabilities: create tab blocks with Markdown-formatted titles
lazy-load only the active tab body
build equal or weighted column layouts
add, delete, reorder and edit tabs via right-click, drag and controls
configure separators, controls and layout options in settings
extras: Warns that another enabled plugin using the columns fenced language may conflict; drag-and-drop of tab titles is desktop-only; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
intentEvidence: Tabbed is a compatibility-focused successor to Huajin's Markdown Tabs, which was inspired by Code Tab.
problem: Obsidian notes have no native Markdown syntax for tabbed content or equal-column layouts, and heavy embeds or Bases load even when not being viewed.

relations.evidence: successor to Huajin's Markdown Tabs, which was inspired by Code Tab

summary: Markdown block plugin that adds lazy-loading tab containers and column layouts in notes, rendering only the active tab body.
